# fopost_automation (Resource)

A FoPost automation: one trigger and the ordered steps it runs. The steps are declared in order, and the API numbers them from that order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fopost_workspace" "acme" {
  name = "Acme Social"
  slug = "acme-social"
}

resource "fopost_automation" "blog_to_social" {
  workspace_id = fopost_workspace.acme.id
  name         = "Blog to social"
  trigger_type = "rss_feed"

  trigger_config = jsonencode({
    feed_url = "https://acme.example.com/blog/feed.xml"
  })

  step {
    action_type = "delay"

    action_config = jsonencode({
      minutes = 15
    })
  }

  step {
    action_type = "publish"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the automation.
- `trigger_type` (String) What starts a run. One of `cross_post`, `rss_feed`, `api_webhook`, or `schedule`. The trigger type is fixed once created, so changing it replaces the automation.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the automation runs in. An automation cannot move between workspaces, so changing this replaces it.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the automation runs when its trigger fires. Defaults to `true`.
- `step` (Block List) One action in the automation. Declare at least one; the order of the blocks is the order the steps run in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))
- `trigger_config` (String) Trigger settings as a JSON object, e.g. `jsonencode({ feed_url = "https://example.com/feed.xml" })`. The shape depends on `trigger_type`. Compared semantically, so formatting never produces a diff.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the automation was created.
- `id` (String) The automation's server-assigned identifier.
- `last_triggered_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last run.
- `run_count` (Number) How many times the automation has run.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret for an `api_webhook` trigger. The API returns it only at creation, so an imported automation has none and the value stays null.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the automation.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) What the step does. One of `publish`, `delay`, or `transform`.

Optional:

- `action_config` (String) Step settings as a JSON object, e.g. `jsonencode({ minutes = 30 })` for a `delay`. The shape depends on `action_type`. Compared semantically, so formatting never produces a diff.

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) The step's server-assigned position, taken from the order the blocks are declared in.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fopost_automation.blog_to_social atm_01hzy8example
```
